english.title: Fail to construct or maintain gauge or weir to measure water flow as required by drought order or permit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to

(A)_[construct]_
(B)_[maintain in good order]_

(C)_[a gauge]_
(D)_[a weir]_
(E)_[apparatus for measuring the flow of water]_

which you were required to construct or maintain by a drought

(F)_[order made on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER MADE..) under section 73]_
(G)_[permit issued on **(..SPECIFY DATE PERMIT ISSUED..) under section 79A]_

of the Water Resources Act 1991
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80(2)(a) and (4) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
failed to construct or maintain in good order
a gauge, weir or other apparatus for measuring the flow of water
which you were required to construct or maintain by a drought order or permit

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: In any proceedings for an offence under this section, it shall be a defence for the defendant to show that he took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of the offence.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
